title: In Vitro Growth and Maturation of Mouse Oocytes from Secondary Follicles
author: Hidetaka Tasaki

steps.title: Euthanize mice and collect ovaries
steps.instruction: Euthanize female mice according to institutional animal‑care guidelines and immediately harvest both ovaries.

steps.title: Mince ovaries in handling medium
steps.instruction: Using 26‑gauge needles, mince the ovaries in handling medium.

steps.title: Prepare enzyme solution
steps.instruction: On the day of use, dilute frozen 100× stocks of collagenase type IA and DNase I in handling medium to final concentrations of 2 mg/mL collagenase type IA and 0.2 mg/mL DNase I; warm before use.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion of tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer the minced tissue to the enzyme solution and incubate at 37 °C for 20 min (adjust time if over‑ or under‑digestion is observed).

steps.title: Wash and release follicles
steps.instruction: Move the digested fragments to fresh handling medium, then gently pipette with a wide‑bore tip (cut to match tissue size) to release follicles while minimizing mechanical damage.

steps.title: Remove stromal and thecal tissue
steps.instruction: Under a stereomicroscope, repeatedly pipette each follicle with a fine glass capillary to strip adhering stromal and thecal tissue.

steps.title: Select secondary follicles
steps.instruction: Choose secondary follicles 100–120 μm in diameter that have a centrally located oocyte and intact granulosa layers; use gentle pipetting to reduce residual stromal tissue, applying the same criterion across experiments.

steps.title: Prepare low‑attachment 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Using a fine glass capillary with an L‑shaped tip, place one selected follicle into each well of a low‑attachment 96‑well plate containing 100 μL IVG medium; leave the outermost row and column empty and fill them with autoclaved sterile water to limit evaporation.

steps.title: In vitro growth culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C in a humidified 5 % CO₂ atmosphere for 12 days. Every other day, replace 50 μL (half) of the medium with fresh IVG medium. (Optional) Record follicle diameter at defined intervals under the stereomicroscope.

steps.title: Select mature follicles for IVM
steps.instruction: After 12 days, identify follicles that have reached ≥300 μm in diameter and transfer each to IVM medium.

steps.title: Isolate cumulus‑oocyte complexes
steps.instruction: Mechanically isolate the cumulus‑oocyte complex (COC) from each follicle using a fine glass capillary.

steps.title: In vitro maturation of COCs
steps.instruction: Place one COC in a 10 μL drop of IVM medium under mineral oil; culture at 37 °C, humidified 5 % CO₂ for 16–17 h.

steps.title: Cumulus removal
steps.instruction: After maturation, add hyaluronidase solution (M2 medium + 1 mg/mL hyaluronidase) and gently pipette to completely remove cumulus cells.

steps.title: Select MII oocytes
steps.instruction: Identify fully denuded oocytes that have extruded the first polar body; these are MII oocytes.

steps.title: Prepare handling medium
steps.instruction: Dissolve in Leibovitz’s L‑15 medium: 2.5 % (v/v) FBS, 1 mg/mL PVA, and 1 % (v/v) antibiotic‑antimycotic solution; filter‑sterilize (0.22 μm) and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare IVG medium
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.5 mM AA‑2G and 1 % (v/v) penicillin‑streptomycin in αMEM; add 2 % (w/v) PVP onto the surface and let dissolve overnight at 4 °C. Next day, filter‑sterilize (0.45 μm) and store at 4 °C. On the day of use, supplement with L‑glutamine, FBS, FSH, and ITS to obtain final composition: αMEM + 2 % (w/v) PVP + 2 mM L‑glutamine + 1.5 mM AA‑2G + 5 % (v/v) FBS + 0.1 IU/mL FSH + 1 % (v/v) ITS + 1 % (v/v) penicillin‑streptomycin.

steps.title: Prepare IVM medium
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.5 mM AA‑2G and 1 % (v/v) penicillin‑streptomycin in αMEM; filter‑sterilize (0.22 μm) and store at 4 °C. On the day of use, add L‑glutamine, FBS, FSH, EGF, and hCG to achieve final composition: αMEM + 2 mM L‑glutamine + 1.5 mM AA‑2G + 5 % (v/v) FBS + 0.1 IU/mL FSH + 5 ng/mL EGF + 1.2 IU/mL hCG + 1 % (v/v) penicillin‑streptomycin.

steps.title: Prepare hyaluronidase solution
steps.instruction: Supplement M2 medium with 1 mg/mL hyaluronidase; aliquot, freeze, and warm before use.
